My brother has been battling cancer for a year and a half and recently decided to stop chemo because he wants to be able to just rest with what time he has left. He's also always been too proud and, frankly, too sick to put himself online and try to get outside help for the financial side of things. The fact that there are cutesy teenagers on TikTok, pretending to be going through what he's actually gone through, taking people's money, pushing "vitamins" as miracle cures... it's beyond revolting.

UPDATE: My brother passed away two days ago. My family and I want to thank all of you who've sent your love and kind words. This wasn't my initial intention with this comment, but it fills me with hope for humanity that so many people read this and connected with it. I'm so sorry to everyone else who has lost someone to cancer or had to battle cancer themselves. 💔❤
